about: 'Words Into Birds', the weekly crossword (words-into-birds.html). Edited by hand, like lyrics.json: one puzzle a week, exactly 20 clues: 15 about The Hip, each { answer, enum, clue }, written here by hand, and 5 linking words ("link": true) that node scripts/build-bird-grids.js picks from data/bird-links.json to tie the Hip answers together. answer is capital letters only; enum is the word lengths shown after the clue. The builder adds the grid (rows, cols, and row, col, dir, num on each clue) to new puzzles and never touches one that has a grid. Once the game opens, only add puzzles to the end: never change, reorder or remove one that is scheduled (node scripts/check-game-schedule.js). Where each clue's fact comes from: docs/The Hip Handbook - Crossword Clue Bank.md.
